notes: Cai dat: tai file HPCONS-BIM-Setup-2.0.2.exe ben duoi, DONG Revit roi chay (can quyen Admin). - Nut "DAT THEO TRUC" (thay cho chon 2 diem): chon 2 truc vuong goc, goc ngoai buong thang dat tai giao truc, chieu dai thang hang voi truc; xoay 90 do / lat long buong truoc khi dung. Tick "Keo dai" ma chua nhap "Dai toi da" -> tu do truc ke tiep va keo toi do. - Che do "dai buong = nhip 2 truc": chon 2 truc song song (tim tuong canh ngan trung truc) + 1 truc vuong goc (tim tuong ngoai), phuong an tu tinh lai (keo het nhip khi tick "Keo dai", khong tick = chieu dai toi thieu); o "mep canh ngan cach truc" (che do 2 truc thuong) va "mep tuong ngoai cach truc bien" (ca 2 che do). - Tuy chon "Tao chieu...
